text: Cool title - I am already intrigued! :-)

It is unusual to divide the chapter into Hook, Anker, and Teaser subsections. For the final expose, I suggest that you put it into one text.

The research questions can stay in their own section.
Good hook, but there is no real problem here that this research is trying to solve. Maybe you could add a sentence to make the topic more urgent.
aims "to" provide
into
learners, (comma)
better: of implementing such systems

will be informed?
I don't understand. Maybe you meant: will inform?
This is a very general RQ. WIthout reading further, I am curious how to tackle and test this question.
A reference for some of the claims would be nice
I thought this was a typo. Then I looked up the reference, and realized that the author is really named "Suzanna Suzanna". :-)

Please include the reference in the appropriate sentence:
"children [4]."

This is true for all following references
Good - the only thing missing now is a sentence on how you work will differ and improve upon the SOTA. What is the research gap, and how will you address it?
This reference seems to be wrong. [5] is a different publication by Zhang
This methods description is too vague. How many interviews? How many "segments"? What will the interviews be about?
Good!

The bibliography section is quite small. I would expect some references to holographic methods in general, or holographic technology. Also, more citations of approaches on music education would strengthen the exposé.
Venue is missing
Inconsistent - Month + Year here, but only Year for the other references

I miss a direct correlation between your research questions and the proposed methodology. How do your methods answer the three RQs? Do you ask about the qualities and features (RQ1) in your questionnaire? What is the concrete product of your work? And are there any challenges from a computer science perspective, or is this study purely on gathering information?
Good
